item.title: Aggressive bowls maintenance operative, 4th September
item.description:
Dog walking this am encountered an aggressive employee who wanted a fight, over dogs entering the bowls area. He was swearing in an aggressive manner at both me and my dogs, He identified himself as the groundsman.I explained the simple solution would be to contact the council for fence repair. I would question whether he should be in a role that is public facing. He seemed to forget he is a public servant and not in authority to order a rate paying dog walker to only use certain parts of the park. i would appreciate this be investigated further as a matter of urgency as i would not want a member of the public especially a woman to be subjected to this type of behaviour.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Woolwich Road, Barnehurst, Bexleyheath, Greater London
